prompt: Fixed camera on a tripod, framing unchanged. From the first moment, a warm evening breeze stirs the bamboo on the left: the fine leaves flutter and the tall stems lean gently and sway back. The palm in the middle rocks its fronds slowly. The low sun behind the bamboo flickers and shimmers as leaves pass across it, little bursts of golden light breaking through and closing again. Far off, thin haze drifts slowly sideways over the layered hills. The thatched roofs at the bottom stay solid and still. The whole upper part of the frame remains a smooth, plain apricot sky, evenly lit from edge to edge. Calm, quiet, real footage at golden hour.
